name: bg-animated-fractal-dot-grid
title: Animated Dot Grid
blurb: Canvas-rendered dot grid ripples outward from cursor with glowing wave effect.
description: Fullscreen canvas background with dot grid. On pointer movement, dots create radial wave with glow and optional noise overlay. Includes responsive performance scaling and mouse glow effect.
use_when: High-impact hero or section background needing smooth interactive pointer feedback.
avoid_when: Low-power devices, frequent window resizing, or minimal motion preferences.
a11y: Decorative animation tied to mouse movement; no keyboard or motion-reduced variant.
